# Link

`content/link` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A standalone text link with descriptive text, optionally with an arrow.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | text |  |
| `href` | url |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Underlined link in the brand link color.
- **arrow**: Bold link with a trailing arrow, no underline. Sets `arrow: true`, `weight: bold`, `underline: false`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `level` | one of `body`, `bodyLarge`, `bodySmall`, `caption` | `"body"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.link"` |
| `weight` | one of `normal`, `bold` | `"normal"` |
| `underline` | boolean | `true` |
| `arrow` | boolean | `false` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.md 0"` |
| `darkMode` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Underline and color honored. | Fine. | Link color swaps via dm-text where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/link', {
  "label": "Read the full story",
  "href": "https://example.com/journal/summer-notes"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/link",
  "data": {
    "label": "Read the full story",
    "href": "https://example.com/journal/summer-notes"
  }
}
```
